description.en: Free-camera photo mode for Phantom Blade Zero. Enter with F2, freeze time, hide the HUD and tune camera movement here. The last section offers keyboard hotkey choices; depth-of-field details, look and colour settings are edited in settings.json or the optional PBZ-Framework-Menu (F8).
description.zh-Hans: 《影之刃零》自由摄影模式。按 F2 进入，可冻结时间、隐藏 HUD，并在这里调整相机与移动参数。最后一组可直接选择键盘键位；景深详细参数、画面效果、调色与手柄组合键请编辑 PBZPhotoModeCpp.settings.json，或使用可选的 PBZ-Framework-Menu（F8）菜单。

help.en: On: time pauses automatically when photo mode starts, so characters and effects hold still.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：进入摄影模式时自动暂停时间，角色和特效保持不动。

help.en: On: the game receives no movement or attack input while photo mode is active.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：摄影模式期间游戏收不到移动和攻击输入。

help.en: On: the mouse wheel changes the field of view.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：鼠标滚轮调整视野。

help.en: On: scrolling up widens the view instead of narrowing it.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：向上滚动放大视野，而不是拉近。

help.en: On: lifts the 16:9 framing restriction while photo mode is active, for 21:9 and 32:9 screens.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：摄影模式期间解除 16:9 画幅限制，适配 21:9 / 32:9 屏幕。

help.en: On: reuses the game camera each frame so the view does not jump on entry; falls back to a separate camera if takeover fails.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：每帧接管游戏相机，进入时视角不跳变；接管失败会自动回退独立相机。

help.en: On: poll the gamepad and enable the gamepad bindings.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：轮询手柄并启用手柄按键。

help.en: True pause stops enemies, NPCs and effects; slow motion is the fallback.
help.zh-Hans: 真暂停会停住敌人、NPC 和特效；慢动作是备用方式。

help.en: On: hide the player character while photo mode is active.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：摄影模式期间隐藏玩家角色。

help.en: On: hide health bars, quick slots and quest prompts.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：隐藏血条、快捷栏和任务提示。

help.en: On: hide the E-button icon next to interactable objects.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：隐藏可互动物体旁的 E 键图标。

help.en: On: hide enemy health bars above enemies.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：隐藏敌人头顶的血条。

help.en: On: hide the white lock-on marker and the locked target's health bar.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：隐藏锁定白点和被锁定目标的血条。

help.en: On: hide dialogue subtitles while photo mode is active.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：摄影模式期间隐藏对话字幕。

help.en: On: pause sequencer cutscenes together with the world when frozen.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：冻结时一并暂停 Sequencer 过场。

help.en: On: stop the dialogue Flow widget while frozen, so a line does not advance.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：冻结期间停住对话 Flow，台词不会继续推进。

help.en: On: pause Wwise voices one by one when frozen, keeping the current line's position.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：冻结时逐条暂停 Wwise 语音，保留当前句位置。

help.en: On: mute the whole Wwise engine only when no per-voice IDs were captured.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：只有没截获到逐语音 ID 时，才整引擎静音兜底。

help.en: On: cancel camera shakes and modifiers while frozen, for a perfectly still frame.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：冻结时取消镜头抖动和修饰器，画面完全静止。

help.en: On: zero wind strength so cloth and foliage stop swaying while frozen.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：冻结时把风力归零，布料和植被停止摆动。

help.en: On: hold material parameter collections at their frozen snapshot.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：冻结期间钉住材质参数集合的快照值。

help.en: On: suspend character and enemy cloth simulation, keeping the last pose.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：挂起角色和敌人的布料模拟，保留最后姿态。

help.en: On: pause skeletal animation so capes and hair do not keep moving while frozen.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：暂停骨骼动画，冻结期间披风和头发不会继续动。

help.en: On: turn motion blur off while frozen to remove residual smearing.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：冻结时关闭动态模糊，消除残留拖影。

help.en: Field of view used when photo mode starts.
help.zh-Hans: 进入摄影模式时的视野角度。

help.en: Step used by the numpad plus/minus keys.
help.zh-Hans: 小键盘 +/- 调整视野时的步进。

help.en: Camera translation speed in units per second.
help.zh-Hans: 相机平移速度（单位/秒）。

help.en: Multiplier while the boost key is held.
help.zh-Hans: 按住加速键时的倍率。

help.en: Multiplier while the slow key is held.
help.zh-Hans: 按住减速键时的倍率。

help.en: Look sensitivity multiplier while the slow key is held.
help.zh-Hans: 按住减速键时视角灵敏度的倍率。

help.en: Degrees of camera rotation per mouse unit.
help.zh-Hans: 每单位鼠标位移对应的视角旋转角度。

help.en: Maximum up/down tilt in degrees.
help.zh-Hans: 上下俯仰的最大角度。

help.en: Speed of the rise/descend keys.
help.zh-Hans: 升降键的平移速度。

help.en: Roll speed in degrees per second.
help.zh-Hans: 滚转速度（度/秒）。

help.en: Tilt speed of the arrow keys and D-pad.
help.zh-Hans: 方向键与十字键的俯仰速度。

help.en: Turn speed of the arrow keys and D-pad.
help.zh-Hans: 方向键与十字键的转向速度。

help.en: What the vertical mouse keys do: translate the camera or tilt it.
help.zh-Hans: 鼠标升降键的行为：上下平移相机，或俯仰视角。

help.en: On: enable engine depth of field. Focus distance, F-stop and sensor width are set in PBZPhotoModeCpp.settings.json.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：启用引擎景深。对焦距离、光圈和传感器宽度在 PBZPhotoModeCpp.settings.json 里设置。

help.en: Right-stick turn speed at full deflection, in degrees per second.
help.zh-Hans: 右摇杆满行程的转速（度/秒）。

help.en: Left-stick movement as a fraction of the camera move speed.
help.zh-Hans: 左摇杆移动占相机移动速度的比例。

help.en: Stick deadzone, 0 to 0.5.
help.zh-Hans: 摇杆死区，0 到 0.5。

help.en: Choose the key for this action. The list has 64 common keys; for any other key (or a mouse side button), edit key_toggle in PBZPhotoModeCpp.settings.json.
help.zh-Hans: 选择该操作使用的按键。列表提供 64 个常用键；其它键（或鼠标侧键）请编辑 PBZPhotoModeCpp.settings.json 的 key_toggle。
